scope: reusable physical paving construction and refined optical-water transfer across unrelated historic and contemporary hosts
acceptedSystemEvidence: the paving compiler enforces factual-reference-backed nominal and actual unit dimensions, joint width and recess, maximum exposed relief, settlement and aspect ratio while excluding legitimate boundary cuts from whole-unit measurement
historic setts use 200 by 100 by 75 millimetre nominal units with 10 millimetre joints and contemporary blocks use 200 by 100 by 50 millimetre nominal units with 4 millimetre joints
terminal courses produce bounded cut units rather than stretching one paver to fill a remainder
surface-water profiles are derived through a live hash-bound receiver rebind that validates every material target, embedded water response and shelter artifact instead of hand-editing JSON
historic and contemporary fields solve 3157 and 3654 active cells with mass-balance errors of 4.829470157119431e-15 and 7.244205235679146e-15 cubic metres
four-times subcell refinement produces 32648 and 38780 joined optical triangles at 0.03 metre refined cell size while preserving exact source puddle volumes
the v2 optical surface carries explicit 1.333 IOR, 0.035 roughness and depth-derived Beer-Lambert transmittance into the Cycles thin-dielectric renderer path
both authoritative-profile probes pass all structural, hash, reconstruction, render, lighting, finite-fog and camera checks

side-by-side visual inspection confirms that the previous large black missing-paver and hole-like silhouettes are absent on both hosts and that paving relief and unit scale are materially more plausible
blockingVisualDefects: neither assembled host reaches production photorealism and neither environment or material asset is publishable from this evidence
historic unit response remains excessively noisy, contrasty and repetitive, with insufficient coherent dirt, wear and ageing across courses
contemporary concrete remains chalky and repetitive, while broad wet reflections do not yet contain enough small-scale roughness and drainage variation
facade shells, glazing, inhabited interiors and architectural joins remain sparse, clean and visibly blockout-like
rain still lacks integrated receiver splash, runoff, mist and convincing depth-dependent density
the one shared evening HDRI is valid transfer evidence but is not a sufficient environment family for varied production worlds
nextGenericDependencies: semantically selected source materials and multi-scale per-unit colour, roughness, dirt, wear and edge variation without photographed-layout duplication
layered facade construction materials, believable bevel frequency, staining, runoff and repair history
denser portable inhabited-interior kits with glazing, furnishing and practical-light variation
receiver-aware splash, runoff, mist and depth-layered precipitation integration
additional provenance-bound environment illumination families selected by host, weather and time-of-day semantics

queuedReusableWork.productionClothing: Remains queued behind the current higher-priority environment/material work exactly as recorded in docs/progress/cinematic-system.md; this audit does not reprioritise it or convert it into benchmark-specific polishing.

notes: The benchmark was not rerendered. These unrelated architectural hosts were used as a reusable-system transfer audit. Passing the targeted paving/water defect does not override the assembled production-environment rejection.
